closedOwnedOverlap.head: 54844293b8ea82350531b8da92336b325d5ab7ec
closedOwnedOverlap.body:
## Completed qualification: closed without promotion

The unchanged owned-overlap design does **not** provide a review-worthy complete JMdict import gain on the current baseline. Both independent opposite-order hosts finished their full schedules and failed the original timing gates. Closing this draft without merging.

| JMdict host | Paired median change | Equal-work change | Faster pairs | 95% paired median interval | Identical-code control median |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| AB | −0.35 ms / −0.0525% | +1.1783% | 6/12 | [−1.3355%, +1.2804%] | +1.6537% |
| BA | +15.40 ms / +1.8676% | +1.5151% | 3/12 | [−0.3239%, +4.2180%] | +0.7763% |

Negative is faster. Each host retains twelve candidate/baseline pairs, four unchanged-code control pairs and four excluded warmups. No observation was removed, retried or pooled across hosts. Both semantic and separate memory screens passed; neither timing result meets the predeclared ≥10 ms and ≥1% improvement, nine faster pairs, negative confidence intervals and control requirements.

The earlier standalone compression result justified investigation, but it did not carry through to the complete import. Existing diagnostics confirm overlapping sink callbacks in all24 candidate observations. Parser-worker wall durations increase on both hosts; those overlapping clocks suggest contention/queueing for future analysis and do not establish a removable CPU cost.

### Exact source and validation

- Baseline: `dcfc02a0a5534929b1e9fa1f2801ec7a0784ea16`.
- Product head: `54844293b8ea82350531b8da92336b325d5ab7ec`.
- Qualification source: `c98110712296be803fcb30b9295bb11c7d0b44bc`; [run46132124178](https://github.com/ManabiIO/manabitan/actions/runs/46132124178).
- Current verification passed: JavaScript lint, main/test types,674 unit files /15186 tests passed /47 skipped,42 Python receipt tests, and all-target **dry-run** validation.
- Both complete JMdict artifact ZIPs were independently downloaded and verified. Every prescribed observation and source identity matches; exact package changes, semantic receipts, paired arithmetic and the seeded bootstrap pass the audit.
- [Durable raw observations, full logs, source identities, memory receipts, reproducible audit and mechanism diagnostics](https://github.com/ManabiIO/manabitan/tree/0000b582cb442f8d75aa5076ed611075aab7c9c8/builds/perf/import-overlap-20261128-da6c4/owned-completed-jmdict).
- [Complete experiment record](https://github.com/ManabiIO/manabitan/blob/0000b582cb442f8d75aa5076ed611075aab7c9c8/dev/perf/import-experiments-20260914.md), including the historical rationale and superseded failures.

Remaining Jitendex/VNDB observations and audits are being retained for completeness. They cannot change this failed primary JMdict promotion decision. A materially different design would require a separately frozen experiment.
